Method of Attack: Data-stealing malware systematically gathering sensitive information from web browsers, including cookies and saved passwords, saving data into temporary files, uploading to transfer[.]sh, and exfiltrating host information via a Telegram bot API URL.
Creating a scheduled task on the system to maintain persistence.
Deploying a malicious executable on Windows NT hosts and leveraging native Python code on Linux-based hosts.
Attack Vector: Malicious Python package installed from the PyPi repository.
Exfiltration of data via Telegram bot API and transfer[.]sh.
